rows.verbatim: 2. Wind turbine

options: Wind activates the turning of the blades and rotor. They spin the main shaft and gearbox, which spins the generator resulting in electrical output
They can be connected to batteries or the national grid

When the wind flows across the blade, the air pressure on one side of the blade decreases. The difference in air pressure across the two sides of the blade creates both lift and drag. The force of the lift is stronger than the drag and this causes the rotor to spin
An inverter is needed to convert the direct current (DC) voltage from the turbine to match the alternating current (AC) voltage required for domestic use

If the turbine sits on a tower, then a concrete foundation is generally required

rows.verbatim: 3. Photovoltaic cells
